look.why: A glacial Arctic cyan-aqua that mirrors icy fjords while highlighting the ivory spiral tusk.

size.measure: body length 4–5 m, plus spiral ivory tusk up to 2–3 m

habitat.text: Cold Arctic waters, fjords, and pack-ice leads around Canada, Greenland, Norway, and Russia.

diet.text: Greenland halibut, Arctic cod, squid, and shrimp caught during deep winter dives.

facts.text: Its famous spiral 'horn' is actually an elongated upper-left canine tooth packed with up to 10 million nerve endings.
Regularly dives deeper than 1,500 metres beneath dense Arctic sea ice to feed on deep-water halibut.
